svg.text: Keys on a ring, not a modulo
adding one node to four should move one arc, not every key.
what moves when a fifth node joins
8 of these 10 keys land somewhere new.
2 of 10 move. one arc changes hands.
virtual nodes even out the arcs
three machines, each placed six times.
N5 takes the arc between N1 and N2.
k1 moves to it. k2 through k6 do not move at all.
a key belongs to the first node clockwise from its hash position.
